title: Missing #[non_exhaustive] on YencMetadata and DecodedPart in yencoding
description: YencMetadata and DecodedPart in yencoding/src/lib.rs are all-pub-field structs with no #[non_exhaustive] attribute. Callers can construct them via struct literals. Both are decode output types — callers have no reason to construct them. EncodePartOptions also has all pub fields and no #[non_exhaustive]; it is an input/builder type, so the concern is different — adding an optional field is not a breaking change if #[non_exhaustive] is present, but callers currently rely on exhaustive struct update syntax (.., ..Default::default()) to fill in future fields; without #[non_exhaustive] adding fields IS breaking. What goes wrong: any field addition to any of these three structs requires a major version bump. All three in yencoding/src/lib.rs need #[non_exhaustive].
